items.title: A quasi-splitting of a stable vector bundle produces an etale morphism from the quotient

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a quasi-splitting of a stable vector bundle over a base yields an etale morphism from the associated quotient (author lemma at source lines 7299-7312, label lemma-quasi-splitting-etale). The proof (source lines 7314-7355) forms the groupoid determined by the quasi-splitting, verifies that its relation is an open immersion and applies the flat groupoid criterion for etaleness of a quotient (proof lines 7314-7354). The construction of the groupoid and the verification of openness are the substance. H3.
